subject: pre tag and horizontal scroll bar

messages.author: 53dbab5845ace6b6
messages.subject: pre tag and horizontal scroll bar
parts:
The usual way shiny displays the outcome is to insert it into a <pre> tag.
Now, the output I would like to display is sometimes longer (horizontally) than the width of the pre tag, so what I would like is to have a horizontal bar when this happens.

It probably isn't a shiny issue, but shiny uses <pre>... hence my question here.

By default (as far as I read), the <pre> tag uses word wrapping, which makes no sense with code and formatted text output.

Is there a way to enforce the <pre> tag *not* to do word wrapping?
Alternatively, can shiny use a different HTML tag to display the output?

Thanks,
Adrian

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: pre tag and horizontal scroll bar
parts:
Add this to your UI (somewhere inside shinyUI):

tags$style(type="text/css",
  "pre { white-space: pre; word-wrap: normal; overflow-x: auto; }"
)

(please disregard the previous version I sent)
